# autopilot (fixture)

Kickoff prose whose kill-switch sentence names the same variable the emitter
reads. This half is correct on purpose — the violation this fixture carries is on
the code side alone, and rules 2 and 3 must both pass so the failure can only
have come from rule 1.

- 「이 런의 배너를 전부 끄시려면 런을 시작하기 전에 `CC_CMDS_AUTOPILOT_NOTIFY=0` 을 걸어 주세요 — `off`·`false`·`no` 도 대소문자 구분 없이 같게 읽습니다.」
